notes.title: Minor Update: Localization & Exit Fix
notes.content:
Hello, brave souls who have chosen to sail the sea!

This small update brings community-suggested fixes to improve your experience. Credits and language have been polished, and the game will no longer close at the end of your journey.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! 🐟

notes.title: 🎣 The Chosen Catch - CREATIVE CONTEST
notes.content:
Have you met a fish so strange and captivating it stayed with you long after the tide returned? 

Share a drawing, edit or creation of the most endearing creature you've pulled from the sea in our demo. Add a hat or ribbon? Let your fish have its moment in the spotlight! 

Please ensure all entries are handmade. AI-generated content is not eligible for this contest.


We’ll choose one winner whose art will be featured as our profile pic for a month - plus a big shoutout to celebrate their catch!

🗓️ The contest closes at the end of the Fishing Festival on June 23rd.

🎨 Cast your entry now!






🖼️ To enter, we originally asked for uploads to the “Artwork” section of our Steam Community Hub - but it seems that’s currently not working for some players, especially in the demo version.



So we’re now collecting all entries in a public Google Drive gallery instead!


[hr][/hr]
📬 How to participate:
Send your artwork to 

liquidsquid.help@gmail.com


- Include your name or username so we can credit you!
